name: CMS
summary:
CMS Distribution provides value-added technology distribution across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud-native platforms.

Together, we support organisations with access to modern infrastructure and platform technologies through combined commercial, enablement, and partner delivery capabilities.
overview:
CMS Distribution works with vendors, partners, and enterprise customers to deliver technology solutions across cloud, cybersecurity, datacentre, and modern infrastructure environments.

Together, we help organisations access and adopt modern platform technologies across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure. Through combined commercial alignment, technical enablement, and partner collaboration, we support customers across Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, platform modernisation, and operational transformation initiatives.

Our focus is on helping organisations navigate modern infrastructure technologies with confidence while building long-term platform capability and operational maturity.

As the partnership continues to evolve, we are expanding opportunities around platform delivery, technical enablement, and operational support across cloud-native environments.
